username.title.description: Heading of the sheet a new member must answer right after signing in: they pick the username their account will have.

username.titleForPublic.description: Heading of the same username sheet when it appears later, before a member who joined by invite opens something public for the first time. They may close this one without answering.

username.intro.text: This is your @handle: your sign-in name and your public page address. Letters, numbers and underscores, 3 to 32 characters.
username.intro.description: Explanation under the heading on the sheet where a new member chooses a username: what a username is used for and which characters it may have. Keep @handle as written; the username is shown with an @ in front.

username.introForPublic.text: Public apps show this, not your name. Letters, numbers and underscores, 3 to 32 characters.
username.introForPublic.description: Explanation under the heading on the username sheet shown before a member opens something public: public apps show the username instead of the person's real name, and which characters it may have.

username.fieldLabel.description: Label of the text field on the sheet where a member chooses a username.

username.placeholder.description: Placeholder inside the empty username field: an example of what a username looks like. One lower-case word with no spaces, since a username cannot contain spaces.

username.publicNote.text: Your username will be public to other users on Homeroom.
username.publicNote.description: Note directly under the username field on the choose-a-username sheet: tells the person that everyone on Homeroom can see the username. Homeroom is the product's name.

username.submit.description: Main button on the choose-a-username sheet: saves the username typed in the field and closes the sheet.

username.notNow.description: Secondary button on the username sheet shown before opening something public: closes the sheet without choosing a username, and the person stays where they were.

username.error.empty.description: Error under the username field when the person presses Continue with the field empty.

username.error.notSaved.description: Error under the username field when the server refused the username and gave no reason of its own.

username.error.network.description: Error under the username field when the request to save the username could not reach the server.

username.chosenToast.description: Brief confirmation shown after a username was saved. {{username}} is the username just chosen; keep the @ directly in front of it.

communities.welcome.description: Heading of the first screen a new account sees after choosing a username: a welcome, above a list of communities to join. Homeroom is the product's name.

communities.intro.text: Homeroom is a place where communities build the apps they use together.
communities.intro.description: Sentence under the welcome heading on a new account's first screen: says what Homeroom is. Homeroom is the product's name.

communities.question.text: What communities do you want to join?
communities.question.description: Question above the list of communities on a new account's first screen. Each community in the list can be ticked to join it.

communities.listLabel.description: Accessible name of the list of communities a new account can tick to join, on its first screen.

communities.memberCount_one.description: Read by screen readers for the number shown at the end of a community's row on the join screen: how many members that community has. {{memberCount}} is the number, already formatted with separators, for example 1,284.

communities.memberCount_other.description: Read by screen readers for the number shown at the end of a community's row on the join screen: how many members that community has. {{memberCount}} is the number, already formatted with separators, for example 1,284.

communities.footnote.text: You can join or leave any time from Discover, and start your own private or public community once you are in.
communities.footnote.description: Small print under the list of communities on a new account's first screen. Discover is the name of a tab in the main navigation; write it as that tab is named.

communities.skip.description: Quiet button under the main button on the join-communities screen: goes on without joining any community.

communities.pickOne.description: Text of the main button on the join-communities screen while no community is ticked. The button is disabled; the text tells the person to tick one.

communities.continue.description: Text of the main button on the join-communities screen when the only community ticked is Homeroom's own, which the account is already in: goes on to Home without joining anything.

communities.join_one.description: Text of the main button on the join-communities screen: joins the communities the person ticked. {{count}} is how many.

communities.join_other.description: Text of the main button on the join-communities screen: joins the communities the person ticked. {{count}} is how many.

communities.error.notJoined.text: Could not join those. Try again.
communities.error.notJoined.description: Error above the buttons on the join-communities screen when the server refused the request and gave no reason of its own. "Those" are the communities the person ticked.

communities.error.network.description: Error above the buttons on the join-communities screen when the request could not reach the server.

communities.joinedToast_one.description: Brief confirmation shown after the join-communities screen closes. {{count}} is how many communities the person just joined.

communities.joinedToast_other.description: Brief confirmation shown after the join-communities screen closes. {{count}} is how many communities the person just joined.

terms.updatedToast.text: We updated our terms. By continuing to use Homeroom, you agree to them.
terms.updatedToast.description: Brief notice shown once to a signed-in member who had accepted an earlier version of the terms of use, after the terms changed. Homeroom is the product's name.

buildLine.planning.description: One-line status under a new project's card, on its Home tile and on its hub while its first version is being made: the assistant called Homeroom bot is writing the plan for the project. "it" is the project. Homeroom bot is a name.

buildLine.plan.text: Your plan is ready to review
buildLine.plan.description: One-line status under a new project's card, on its Home tile and on its hub while its first version is being made, shown to the person who started the project: Homeroom bot's plan for it is waiting for them to read and approve.

buildLine.planMember.description: One-line status under a new project's card, on its Home tile and on its hub while its first version is being made, shown to other members while the plan waits for the person who started the project. "it" is the project.

buildLine.question.text: Homeroom bot has a question for you
buildLine.question.description: One-line status under a new project's card, on its Home tile and on its hub while its first version is being made, shown to the person who started the project: the assistant called Homeroom bot asked them something and waits for the answer. Homeroom bot is a name.

buildLine.building.description: One-line status under a new project's card, on its Home tile and on its hub while its first version is being made: the first version is being built now. "Building" is a verb in progress and "it" is the project; nobody is being asked to build anything.

buildLine.testing.description: One-line status under a new project's card, on its Home tile and on its hub while its first version is being made: the first version is built and is being tested. "it" is the project.

buildLine.ready.description: One-line status under a new project's card, on its Home tile and on its hub while its first version is being made: the first version is finished and can be opened and tried, before it goes live.

buildLine.live.description: One-line status under a new project's card, on its Home tile and on its hub while its first version is being made: the first version has been published and the app is running for everyone. An adjective, not the verb "to live".

buildLine.working.text: Homeroom bot is working on it
buildLine.working.description: One-line status on a new project's hub card while the welcome tour is running, in place of the line that asks the person to review the plan. "it" is the project. Homeroom bot is a name.

buildLine.withNote.description: A project's build status followed by a short note, on one line, for example "Building it · usually 10 to 25 min". {{line}} is the status and {{note}} the note, both already translated; only the separator between them is translated.

firstSession.make.startFromIdea.description: Label above the grid of ready ideas (Tier list, A game, Organizer, Your own idea) on the "What do you want to make?" screen, where a member describes a new project.

firstSession.make.ideasLabel.description: Accessible name of the group of idea tiles on the "What do you want to make?" screen, where a member describes a new project.

firstSession.make.ownIdea.description: Label of the fourth tile on the "What do you want to make?" screen, where a member describes a new project: instead of a ready idea, the member writes their own description in a text box.

firstSession.make.briefLabel.description: Label of the field on the "What do you want to make?" screen, where a member describes a new project where the member says what the new app should do. "it" is the app.

firstSession.make.writeItYourself.description: Link beside the "What should it do?" label while a ready idea's sentence is shown: turns that sentence into plain text the member can edit freely. "it" is the description.

firstSession.make.ownWordsLabel.description: Accessible name of the small text field inside a ready idea's sentence, where the member types their own words for the blank.

firstSession.make.finishLabel.text: Finish it in your own words
firstSession.make.finishLabel.description: Label of the box under the game sentence on the "What do you want to make?" screen, where a member describes a new project: the member types the rest of that sentence. "it" is the sentence.

firstSession.make.choicesLabel.description: Accessible name of the row of chips under a ready idea's sentence; each chip fills the sentence's blank with a different option.

firstSession.make.ownChip.description: Chip beside the ready options under an idea's sentence on the "What do you want to make?" screen, where a member describes a new project: lets the member type their own words into the sentence's blank instead of picking an option. Keep the ellipsis.

firstSession.make.briefPlaceholder.text: A map of our favorite swimming spots…
firstSession.make.briefPlaceholder.description: Placeholder in the empty "What should it do?" box: an example of a description a member might write for a new app. Keep the ellipsis.

firstSession.make.waitlistIdea.text: Filled in from your waitlist answer.
firstSession.make.waitlistIdea.description: Hint under the "What should it do?" box when it was filled in with what the member wrote when they joined the waitlist.

firstSession.make.nameLabel.description: Label of the name field on the "What do you want to make?" screen, where a member describes a new project: the name of the new project. "it" is the project.

firstSession.make.namePlaceholder.description: Placeholder in the empty name field on the "What do you want to make?" screen, where a member describes a new project: an example of a project name.

firstSession.make.needed.blank.description: Error under a ready idea's sentence when the member pressed Make it without typing their own words into the sentence's blank.

firstSession.make.needed.finish.description: Error under the game sentence when the member pressed Make it without typing the rest of the sentence in the box.

firstSession.make.needed.brief.text: Say what it should do first.
firstSession.make.needed.brief.description: Error under the empty "What should it do?" box when the member pressed Make it. "it" is the app.

firstSession.make.needed.briefShort.text: Say a little more about what it should do.
firstSession.make.needed.briefShort.description: Error under the "What should it do?" box when the member pressed Make it with a description that is too short. "it" is the app.

firstSession.make.needed.name.text: Give it a name to make it. You can change it later.
firstSession.make.needed.name.description: Error under the empty name field when the member pressed Make it. Both "it" are the project.

firstSession.make.error.notMade.text: Could not make it. Try again.
firstSession.make.error.notMade.description: Error above the Make it button when creating the project failed and the server gave no reason of its own. "it" is the project.

firstSession.make.making.description: Text of the main button on the "What do you want to make?" screen, where a member describes a new project while the project is being created after the member pressed it.

firstSession.make.submit.description: Main button on the "What do you want to make?" screen, where a member describes a new project: creates the project from the description and name. "Make" is a verb and "it" is the project.

firstSession.make.importLink.description: Link under the Make it button, when the screen was opened from the Create button: switches to a form that brings in an existing app from a GitHub repository instead of describing a new one. GitHub is a name.

firstSession.make.lookAround.description: Line under the Make it button on a new member's first screen. <0>…</0> is a link that skips making a project and shows a short tour of Home instead.

firstSession.import.title.description: Heading of the form that brings an existing app in from a GitHub repository as a new project. "Import" is a verb. GitHub is a name.

firstSession.import.line.text: Bring an app that already exists. Your group builds on it from here.
firstSession.import.line.description: Line under the heading on the form that imports an existing app from a GitHub repository as a new project: what importing is for.

firstSession.import.urlLabel.description: Label of the field on the form that imports an existing app from a GitHub repository as a new project where the member pastes the repository's address.

firstSession.import.urlPlaceholder.description: Placeholder in the repository address field on the form that imports an existing app from a GitHub repository as a new project: the shape of a GitHub address. "owner" and "repo" stand for the account's and the repository's names; github.com stays as it is.

firstSession.import.check.description: Button beside the repository address field on the form that imports an existing app from a GitHub repository as a new project: checks that Homeroom's bot account can reach that repository. A verb.

firstSession.import.recheck.description: The same button beside the repository address field after a check succeeded: runs the check again. A verb.

firstSession.import.checking.description: Status under the repository address field while the check runs: Homeroom is finding out whether its bot account can reach the repository.

firstSession.import.hasAccess.description: Status under the repository address field after a successful check. usernode-bot is the name of Homeroom's GitHub account and stays as written; "Write" is GitHub's name for that permission. {{repo}} is the repository, as owner/name. Keep the check mark first.

firstSession.import.inviteBot.text: Invite usernode-bot to the repo first (Write access on an organization repo).
firstSession.import.inviteBot.description: Hint under the repository address field before any check: what the member must do on GitHub first. usernode-bot is the name of Homeroom's GitHub account and stays as written; "Write" is GitHub's name for that permission.

firstSession.import.needed.repo.description: Error under the repository address field when the member pressed Import it before the repository was checked. "Check" is a verb.

firstSession.import.nameLabel.description: Label of the name field on the form that imports an existing app from a GitHub repository as a new project: the name the imported project will have. "it" is the project.

firstSession.import.namePlaceholder.description: Placeholder in the empty name field on the form that imports an existing app from a GitHub repository as a new project: an example of a project name.

firstSession.import.needed.name.text: Give it a name to import it. You can change it later.
firstSession.import.needed.name.description: Error under the empty name field when the member pressed Import it. Both "it" are the project.

firstSession.import.importing.description: Text of the main button on the form that imports an existing app from a GitHub repository as a new project while the import request is running.

firstSession.import.submit.description: Main button on the form that imports an existing app from a GitHub repository as a new project: creates the project from the checked repository. "Import" is a verb and "it" is the app.

firstSession.import.describeInstead.description: Link under the Import it button: goes back to the form where a new project is described in words.

firstSession.import.error.noUrl.text: Paste a GitHub repo URL first.
firstSession.import.error.noUrl.description: Error under the repository address field when the member pressed Check with the field empty.

firstSession.import.error.network.description: Error under the repository address field when the check could not reach the server.

firstSession.import.error.checkFailed.description: Error under the repository address field when the check failed and the server gave no reason. "Check" is a noun here. {{status}} is the numeric HTTP status code, for example 502.

firstSession.import.error.notImported.text: Could not import it. Try again.
firstSession.import.error.notImported.description: Error above the Import it button when the import failed and the server gave no reason of its own. "it" is the repository's app.

firstSession.import.note.unread.text: Couldn’t read this repo’s dapp.json. Anything it sets still applies once it’s imported.
firstSession.import.note.unread.description: Note under the import form after a repository was checked but its settings file could not be read. dapp.json is the name of a settings file in the repository and stays as written.

firstSession.import.note.public.text: Its dapp.json says anyone can find it, join and build, so it starts that way rather than as a private community.
firstSession.import.note.public.description: Note under the import form after a repository was checked: its settings file makes the project open to everyone, to see and to build. "Its" is the repository's and "it" the project. "Build" means making changes to the app. dapp.json is the name of a settings file in the repository and stays as written.

firstSession.import.note.viewPublic.text: Its dapp.json says anyone can see it, and only people invited can build, so it starts that way rather than as a private community.
firstSession.import.note.viewPublic.description: Note under the import form after a repository was checked: its settings file lets everyone see the project but only invited people change it. "Its" is the repository's and "it" the project. "Build" means making changes to the app. dapp.json is the name of a settings file in the repository and stays as written.

firstSession.import.note.buildPublic.text: Its dapp.json says anyone can build it, so it starts that way rather than as a private community.
firstSession.import.note.buildPublic.description: Note under the import form after a repository was checked: its settings file lets anyone make changes to the project. "Its" is the repository's and "it" the project. "Build" means making changes to the app. dapp.json is the name of a settings file in the repository and stays as written.

firstSession.import.note.private.text: Its dapp.json says it is private to the people invited. Its code stays public on GitHub., so it starts that way rather than as a private community.
firstSession.import.note.private.description: Note under the import form after a repository was checked, in a rare case: its settings file says anyone may see the project but does not say who may change it. The English is kept exactly as the product has always shown it, stray full stop included. dapp.json is the name of a settings file in the repository and stays as written. GitHub is a name.

firstSession.welcome.opening.description: Accessible name of the placeholder screen shown for a moment after a person follows an invite link, while the community they were invited to loads.

firstSession.welcome.title.description: Heading of the screen an invited person sees right after joining. {{community}} is the name of the community they joined.

firstSession.welcome.goTo.description: Main button on the welcome screen an invited person sees after joining: opens the community and starts a short tour. {{community}} is the community's name.

firstSession.welcome.loadingPeople.description: Accessible name of the placeholder shown on an invited person's welcome screen while the list of the community's members loads. "it" is the community.

firstSession.welcome.member.you.description: Line under the viewer's own name in the list of members on an invited person's welcome screen: marks which row is them.

firstSession.welcome.member.invitedYou.description: Line under a member's name in the list of members on an invited person's welcome screen: this is the person who invited the viewer. Read as "(this person) invited you".

firstSession.people.count_one.description: How many people are in a community: the heading over the list of members on an invited person's welcome screen, and the screen-reader text for a row of members' faces. {{count}} is the number.

firstSession.people.count_other.description: How many people are in a community: the heading over the list of members on an invited person's welcome screen, and the screen-reader text for a row of members' faces. {{count}} is the number.

firstSession.people.you.description: Accessible name of the row of faces above a newly made project, which shows who is in its community: only the viewer so far.

firstSession.people.youAndName.description: Accessible name of the row of faces above a newly made project, which shows who is in its community: the viewer and one other member. {{name}} is that member's username or name.

firstSession.people.youAndOthers_one.description: Accessible name of the row of faces above a newly made project, which shows who is in its community: the viewer and other members. {{count}} is how many others.

firstSession.people.youAndOthers_other.description: Accessible name of the row of faces above a newly made project, which shows who is in its community: the viewer and other members. {{count}} is how many others.

firstSession.made.communityLabel.description: Heading on the screen shown right after a project is made, above the new project's card: making a project also made a community for it.

firstSession.made.inviteHint.text: Invite people to use it and help improve it together.
firstSession.made.inviteHint.description: Line above the buttons on the screen shown right after a project is made, before any invite has been sent. "it" is the new app.

firstSession.made.noBotNote.text: Your description is its first request. You or anyone you invite can build it from there.
firstSession.made.noBotNote.description: Note under the new project's card on the screen shown right after a project is made, when the assistant Homeroom bot is not building it: the description the maker wrote was filed as the project's first request (a request is an item asking for a change). "Build" means making that change.

firstSession.made.sent.copied.description: Line above the buttons on the screen shown right after a project is made, once the invite link was copied to the clipboard.

firstSession.made.sent.copiedTour.text: Link copied. Next, a short tour.
firstSession.made.sent.copiedTour.description: Line above the buttons on the screen shown right after a project is made, once the invite link was copied to the clipboard, when a short tour of Homeroom comes next.

firstSession.made.sent.shared.description: Line above the buttons on the screen shown right after a project is made, once the invite link was handed to the device's share sheet. "Invite" is a noun.

firstSession.made.sent.sharedTour.text: Invite shared. Next, a short tour.
firstSession.made.sent.sharedTour.description: Line above the buttons on the screen shown right after a project is made, once the invite link was handed to the device's share sheet, when a short tour of Homeroom comes next. "Invite" is a noun.

firstSession.made.shareInvite.description: Main button on the screen shown right after a project is made: opens a sheet for sending an invite link to the new community. "Share" is a verb and "invite" a noun.

firstSession.made.shareAgain.description: Button on the screen shown right after a project is made after an invite link has gone out: opens the invite sheet again to send the link once more. "Share" is a verb.

firstSession.made.inviteLater.description: Secondary button on the screen shown right after a project is made, before any invite has been sent: goes on without inviting anyone now.

firstSession.made.startTour.description: Button on the screen shown right after a project is made once an invite has gone out, on a new member's first session: goes on to a short tour of Homeroom.

firstSession.made.goTo.description: Button on the screen shown right after a project is made once an invite has gone out, when the project was started from the Create button: opens the new project. {{community}} is its name.

firstSession.made.sketching.description: Read by screen readers on the screen shown right after a project is made while a preview card for the project is being drawn from what the maker wrote. {{app}} is the project's name.

firstSession.made.needsYou.description: Small label over a card on the screen shown right after a project is made that waits for the maker to do something: answer a plan, retry a setup that failed, or set secrets. Read as "this needs you".

firstSession.made.planWaits.text: Homeroom bot has a plan for {{app}}
firstSession.made.planWaits.description: Title of the card on the screen shown right after a project is made when the assistant called Homeroom bot has written a plan and waits for the maker's answer. {{app}} is the project's name. Homeroom bot is a name.

firstSession.made.planAnswer.text: Answer it in your chat, and it starts building.
firstSession.made.planAnswer.description: Line under the title of the card that says Homeroom bot has a plan: the first "it" is the plan, the second is Homeroom bot, which starts building the app once the plan is answered.

firstSession.made.goToChat.description: Button on the card that says Homeroom bot has a plan: opens the maker's chat with Homeroom bot, where the plan is answered.

firstSession.made.stalled.failed.text: Setup stopped before it was running
firstSession.made.stalled.failed.description: Title of the card on the screen shown right after a project is made when setting the project up failed. "it" is the app.

firstSession.made.stalled.needsSecrets.description: Title of the card on the screen shown right after a project is made when the project cannot start until its secrets are set. Secrets are private configuration values such as API keys. "It" is the app.

firstSession.made.stalled.setSecrets.description: Button on the card that says the project needs secrets to start: opens the dialog where the project's secrets (private configuration values such as API keys) are entered. "Set" is a verb.

firstSession.made.line.failed.description: Status line on the new project's plain card on the screen shown right after a project is made: setting the project up stopped with an error. "it" is the project.

firstSession.made.line.needsSecrets.text: It needs its secrets before it can start.
firstSession.made.line.needsSecrets.description: Status line on the new project's plain card on the screen shown right after a project is made: the app waits for its secrets (private configuration values such as API keys) to be set.

firstSession.made.line.importing.description: Status line on the new project's plain card on the screen shown right after a project is made, for a project imported from a GitHub repository: the import is still running. GitHub is a name.

firstSession.made.line.imported.description: Status line on the new project's plain card on the screen shown right after a project is made, for a project imported from a GitHub repository: the import finished and the app is running.

firstSession.made.line.settingUp.description: Status line on the new project's plain card on the screen shown right after a project is made: the project is still being set up. "it" is the project.

firstSession.made.line.readyToUse.description: Status line on the new project's plain card on the screen shown right after a project is made, for a project made from one of Homeroom's ready-made apps: it is set up and can be used now.

firstSession.made.line.versionOneReady.text: Version one is ready to try.
firstSession.made.line.versionOneReady.description: Status line on the new project's plain card on the screen shown right after a project is made: the first version of the app has been built and can be opened and tried.

firstSession.made.line.botBuilds.text: Homeroom bot builds it from your description.
firstSession.made.line.botBuilds.description: Status line on the new project's plain card on the screen shown right after a project is made: the assistant called Homeroom bot will build the app from what the maker wrote. Homeroom bot is a name.

firstSession.made.line.firstRequest.text: Your description is its first request.
firstSession.made.line.firstRequest.description: Status line on the new project's plain card on the screen shown right after a project is made, when Homeroom bot is not building the project: what the maker wrote was filed as the project's first request (an item asking for a change).

firstSession.made.note.failed.text: Trying again usually clears it. If it stops again, ask an admin.
firstSession.made.note.failed.description: Second line under the new project's card on the screen shown right after a project is made, when setting the project up failed. "it" is first the problem, then the setup.

firstSession.made.note.needsSecrets.text: Set them, and it finishes starting.
firstSession.made.note.needsSecrets.description: Second line under the new project's card on the screen shown right after a project is made, when the project waits for its secrets. "them" are the secrets (private configuration values) and "it" is the app.

firstSession.made.note.imported.text: Its repo says what it does. You and anyone you invite build on it from here.
firstSession.made.note.imported.description: Second line under the new project's card on the screen shown right after a project is made, for a project imported from a GitHub repository. "Its repo" is the project's repository; "build on it" means making changes to the app.

firstSession.made.note.readyMade.text: It works as it is. You and anyone you invite can change it from there.
firstSession.made.note.readyMade.description: Second line under the new project's card on the screen shown right after a project is made, for a project made from one of Homeroom's ready-made apps. "change" is a verb: to alter the app.

firstSession.made.note.noBot.text: You or anyone you invite can build it from there.
firstSession.made.note.noBot.description: Second line under the new project's card on the screen shown right after a project is made, when Homeroom bot is not building the project: members build it themselves, starting from the first request. "build" is a verb.

firstSession.made.note.planWaits.text: Homeroom bot is waiting for your go-ahead.
firstSession.made.note.planWaits.description: Second line under the new project's card on the screen shown right after a project is made, when Homeroom bot has sent a plan and will not start building until the maker approves it. Homeroom bot is a name.

firstSession.made.note.making.text: Homeroom is making your app. It will message you when the first version is ready to try, or if it has any questions.
firstSession.made.note.making.description: Second line under the new project's card on the screen shown right after a project is made, while the first version is being built. Homeroom is the product's name.

firstSession.made.people.you.description: Stands where a member's username is shown under the single face in the people row on the screen shown right after a project is made, when the maker's own username is not known yet: the only person here is the reader. Shown alone; lower case in English, like a username.

firstSession.invite.title.description: Heading of the sheet for sending an invite link. {{community}} is the name of the community people are invited to.

firstSession.invite.previewLabel.description: Small label on the sheet for sending an invite link to a community, over a preview of the invite as the people receiving it will see it. "they" are the people invited.

firstSession.invite.line.description: The invite as its receiver sees it: shown in the preview on the sheet for sending an invite link to a community and used as the title of the shared link. {{inviter}} is the name of the member sending the invite and {{community}} the community's name. "you" is the person receiving it.

firstSession.invite.lineAnonymous.description: The invite as its receiver sees it, when the sender's name is not known: shown in the preview on the sheet for sending an invite link to a community and used as the title of the shared link. {{community}} is the community's name.

firstSession.invite.noteDefault.text: I'm making this for us. Join and tell me what it needs.
firstSession.invite.noteDefault.description: Suggested text of the personal note a maker sends with an invite link, already filled in when the sheet opens. Written in the maker's voice, to their friends, while the app is still being made. No exclamation mark.

firstSession.invite.noteLabel.description: Accessible name of the text box on the sheet for sending an invite link to a community where the sender writes a personal note that goes with the link.

firstSession.invite.notePlaceholder.description: Placeholder in the empty note box on the sheet for sending an invite link to a community.

firstSession.invite.noteHint.text: When you share, your note also goes in the group chat as your first message.
firstSession.invite.noteHint.description: Hint under the note box on the sheet for sending an invite link to a community: the note is also posted in the community's chat.

firstSession.invite.shareLink.description: Main button on the sheet for sending an invite link to a community on a phone or tablet: opens the device's share sheet with the invite link. "Share" is a verb.

firstSession.invite.shareOther.description: Secondary button on the sheet for sending an invite link to a community on a computer, beside Copy link: opens the system's share sheet with the invite link. A verb; keep the ellipsis.

firstSession.invite.copyLink.description: Button on the sheet for sending an invite link to a community: copies the note and the invite link to the clipboard. "Copy" is a verb.

firstSession.invite.copied.description: Shown on the Copy link button for a moment after the invite link was copied. Keep the check mark first.

firstSession.invite.status.shared.description: Status on the sheet for sending an invite link to a community after the invite link was handed to the device's share sheet. Keep the check mark first.

firstSession.invite.status.copied.text: Link copied. Paste it in your group chat.
firstSession.invite.status.copied.description: Status on the sheet for sending an invite link to a community after the invite link was copied to the clipboard: tells the sender what to do with it.

firstSession.invite.status.ready.text: Your link is ready. Press Share again to send it.
firstSession.invite.status.ready.description: Status on the sheet for sending an invite link to a community when the link was made but the browser would not open the share sheet: pressing the Share button a second time will work. "Share" names that button.

firstSession.invite.error.noLink.text: Could not make a link. Try again.
firstSession.invite.error.noLink.description: Error on the sheet for sending an invite link to a community when the invite link could not be created and the server gave no reason of its own.

firstSession.invite.error.notShared.text: Could not share the link. Try again.
firstSession.invite.error.notShared.description: Error on the sheet for sending an invite link to a community when sharing the invite link failed.

firstSession.invite.error.notCopied.text: Could not copy the link. Try again.
firstSession.invite.error.notCopied.description: Error on the sheet for sending an invite link to a community when the invite link could not be copied to the clipboard.

firstSession.invite.limits.text: Anyone with the link can join for the next 7 days, up to 25 people.
firstSession.invite.limits.description: Small print at the bottom of the invite sheet: how long the link works and how many people may use it. The numbers 7 and 25 are fixed.

firstSession.tour.counter.description: Small counter at the top of each card of a new member's tour: which card this is. {{step}} is its number and {{total}} how many cards the tour has, for example "3 of 9".

firstSession.tour.skip.description: Button on each card of a new member's tour except the last: ends the tour now.

firstSession.tour.next.description: Button on a card of a new member's tour: goes to the next card.

firstSession.tour.gotIt.description: Button on the last card of a new member's tour: ends the tour.

firstSession.tour.onHome.title.description: Card of the short tour a new member is walked through after joining or making a project, title: points at the project's tile on the Home screen. {{app}} is the project's name. Home is the name of the screen.

firstSession.tour.onHome.text.text: Open it any time from here.
firstSession.tour.onHome.text.description: Card of the short tour a new member is walked through after joining or making a project, text under the title that says the project is on Home. "it" is the app; "here" is its tile on Home.

firstSession.tour.onHome.tap.description: Card of the short tour a new member is walked through after joining or making a project, link on the card that points at the project's tile on Home: asks the person to tap the tile, and taps it for them when pressed.

firstSession.tour.opens.title.description: Card of the short tour a new member is walked through after joining or making a project, title: the app is now open on screen. {{app}} is the project's name.

firstSession.tour.opens.text.text: This is the app your community makes together.
firstSession.tour.opens.text.description: Card of the short tour a new member is walked through after joining or making a project, text under the title that says the app opens here.

firstSession.tour.menu.title.description: Card of the short tour a new member is walked through after joining or making a project, title: points at the Homeroom mark at the top of the app, which opens a menu with a button of this same name.

firstSession.tour.menu.text.text: Every app has this menu. Tap it.
firstSession.tour.menu.text.description: Card of the short tour a new member is walked through after joining or making a project, text: points at the Homeroom mark at the top of an app, which opens the app's menu.

firstSession.tour.menu.tap.description: Card of the short tour a new member is walked through after joining or making a project, link on the card that points at the Homeroom mark: asks the person to tap it, and opens the menu for them when pressed.

firstSession.tour.suggest.title.description: Card of the short tour a new member is walked through after joining or making a project, title: points at the button of this name in the app's menu, where a member says what the app should do differently.

firstSession.tour.suggest.text.text: It doesn't vanish into a feedback box: Homeroom bot starts building it for you, or brings it to the group, and you can follow along.
firstSession.tour.suggest.text.description: Card of the short tour a new member is walked through after joining or making a project, text about the Suggest an improvement button. Each "it" is the suggestion. Homeroom bot is the name of the assistant that builds changes.

firstSession.tour.back.title.description: Card of the short tour a new member is walked through after joining or making a project, title: points at the ✕ button at the top of an open app. Keep the ✕ sign; Home is the name of the screen.

firstSession.tour.back.text.text: Open {{app}} again from Home any time.
firstSession.tour.back.text.description: Card of the short tour a new member is walked through after joining or making a project, text under the title about the ✕ button. {{app}} is the project's name. Home is the name of the screen.

firstSession.tour.back.tap.description: Card of the short tour a new member is walked through after joining or making a project, link on the card about the ✕ button: asks the person to tap ✕, and taps it for them when pressed. Keep the ✕ sign.

firstSession.tour.communities.title.description: Card of the short tour a new member is walked through after joining or making a project, title: points at the Communities tab in the main navigation. {{community}} is the name of the person's new community.

firstSession.tour.communities.text.text: Communities lists every community you're in.
firstSession.tour.communities.text.description: Card of the short tour a new member is walked through after joining or making a project, text about the Communities tab. The first word is the tab's name; write it as the tab is named.

firstSession.tour.communities.tap.description: Card of the short tour a new member is walked through after joining or making a project, link on the card about the Communities tab: asks the person to tap that tab, and taps it for them when pressed. Communities is the tab's name.

firstSession.tour.hub.title.description: Card of the short tour a new member is walked through after joining or making a project, title: the community's hub page is on screen. {{community}} is the community's name; the hub is its main page.

firstSession.tour.hub.text.text: The discussion and the app's changes are here.
firstSession.tour.hub.text.description: Card of the short tour a new member is walked through after joining or making a project, text under the title naming the community's hub. "changes" is a noun: the changes proposed to the app.

firstSession.tour.sayHi.title.text: Say hi, or share an idea
firstSession.tour.sayHi.title.description: Card of the short tour a new member is walked through after joining or making a project, title of the last card for an invited member: points at the community's discussion and its message box.

firstSession.tour.sayHi.text.text: The people using the app decide what goes in.
firstSession.tour.sayHi.text.description: Card of the short tour a new member is walked through after joining or making a project, text of the last card for an invited member: the members decide which changes are made to the app.

firstSession.tour.private.opens.text.text: You and everyone in its community use it, and make it better together.
firstSession.tour.private.opens.text.description: Card of the short tour a new member is walked through after joining or making a project, for a person invited before they have full access: text under the title that says the app opens here. "it" is the app.

firstSession.tour.private.suggest.text.text: Got an idea for {{app}}? Suggest it here. Homeroom bot builds it, or brings it to the group, and you can follow along.
firstSession.tour.private.suggest.text.description: Card of the short tour a new member is walked through after joining or making a project, for a person invited before they have full access: text about the Suggest an improvement button. {{app}} is the project's name. Homeroom bot is the name of the assistant that builds changes.

firstSession.tour.private.hub.text.text: Talk with the group here, and vote on what changes.
firstSession.tour.private.hub.text.description: Card of the short tour a new member is walked through after joining or making a project, for a person invited before they have full access: text under the title naming the community's hub. "changes" is a verb here: vote on what is changed.

firstSession.tour.private.bot.title.description: Card of the short tour a new member is walked through after joining or making a project, for a person invited before they have full access, title: points at the Messages tab, where the assistant called Homeroom bot is. Homeroom bot is a name.

firstSession.tour.private.bot.text.text: Tell it what {{app}} should do next, and it builds it for the group to try. It's always here in Messages.
firstSession.tour.private.bot.text.description: Card of the short tour a new member is walked through after joining or making a project, for a person invited before they have full access: text about Homeroom bot. {{app}} is the project's name. Messages is the name of a tab.

firstSession.tour.private.waitlist.title.description: Card of the short tour a new member is walked through after joining or making a project, for a person invited before they have full access, title of the last card: points at the card on Home for joining the waitlist.

firstSession.tour.private.waitlist.text.text: Join the waitlist to get your spot.
firstSession.tour.private.waitlist.text.description: Card of the short tour a new member is walked through after joining or making a project, for a person invited before they have full access, text of the last card: joining the waitlist is how they get to make apps of their own.

firstSession.tour.maker.bot.title.description: Card of the short tour a new member is walked through after joining or making a project, for the person who made the project, title: points at the Messages tab. Homeroom bot is the name of the assistant and Messages the name of the tab.

firstSession.tour.maker.bot.text.text: It makes {{app}} with you. You can always find it here.
firstSession.tour.maker.bot.text.description: Card of the short tour a new member is walked through after joining or making a project, for the person who made the project: text about Homeroom bot. "It" is Homeroom bot and {{app}} the project's name.

firstSession.tour.maker.bot.tap.description: Card of the short tour a new member is walked through after joining or making a project, link on the card about Homeroom bot: asks the person to tap the Messages tab, and taps it for them when pressed. Messages is the tab's name.

firstSession.tour.maker.working.title.description: Card of the short tour a new member is walked through after joining or making a project, for the person who made the project, title of the last card, shown over their chat with Homeroom bot. {{app}} is the project's name. Homeroom bot is a name.

firstSession.tour.maker.working.text.text: It'll let you know here when there's something to look at.
firstSession.tour.maker.working.text.description: Card of the short tour a new member is walked through after joining or making a project, for the person who made the project, text of the last card. "It" is Homeroom bot and "here" is this chat.

firstSession.tour.maker.plan.title.text: Homeroom bot has a plan for you
firstSession.tour.maker.plan.title.description: Card of the short tour a new member is walked through after joining or making a project, for the person who made the project, title of the last card when Homeroom bot's plan is already waiting in the chat. Homeroom bot is a name.

firstSession.tour.maker.plan.text.text: Answer it here: tap Build it, or tell it what to change.
firstSession.tour.maker.plan.text.description: Card of the short tour a new member is walked through after joining or making a project, for the person who made the project, text of the last card when a plan is waiting. "Build it" is the name of a button under the plan; the first "it" is the plan and the last is Homeroom bot.

firstSession.tour.look.make.title.description: Card of the short tour a new member is walked through after joining or making a project, for a member who chose to look around first, title: points at the tile on Home that starts a new project.

firstSession.tour.look.make.text.text: New project starts a community and its app.
firstSession.tour.look.make.text.description: Card of the short tour a new member is walked through after joining or making a project, for a member who chose to look around first: text about the tile on Home labelled "New project". Write New project as that tile is named.

firstSession.tour.look.discover.title.description: Card of the short tour a new member is walked through after joining or making a project, for a member who chose to look around first, title: points at the Discover tab. Discover is the tab's name.

firstSession.tour.look.discover.text.text: Open any app, or join its community.
firstSession.tour.look.discover.text.description: Card of the short tour a new member is walked through after joining or making a project, for a member who chose to look around first: text about the Discover tab. "Open" and "join" are verbs.

firstSession.tour.look.communities.title.text: Communities you join show up here
firstSession.tour.look.communities.title.description: Card of the short tour a new member is walked through after joining or making a project, for a member who chose to look around first, title: points at the Communities tab.

firstSession.tour.look.communities.text.text: Each one has its own hub and discussion.
firstSession.tour.look.communities.text.description: Card of the short tour a new member is walked through after joining or making a project, for a member who chose to look around first: text about the Communities tab. "Each one" is a community; its hub is its main page.

firstSession.tour.look.bot.title.description: Card of the short tour a new member is walked through after joining or making a project, for a member who chose to look around first, title of the last card: points at the Messages tab. Homeroom bot is the name of the assistant and Messages the name of the tab.

firstSession.tour.look.bot.text.text: It makes apps with you. You can always find it here.
firstSession.tour.look.bot.text.description: Card of the short tour a new member is walked through after joining or making a project, for a member who chose to look around first, text of the last card. "It" is Homeroom bot.

tour.counter.description: Small counter at the top of each card of the welcome tour on the Home screen, started from the Getting started card or from Settings. {{step}} is the card's number and {{total}} how many cards there are, for example "3 of 5".

tour.skip.description: Button on each card of the welcome tour on the Home screen, started from the Getting started card or from Settings: asks whether to leave the tour.

tour.next.description: Button on each card of the welcome tour on the Home screen, started from the Getting started card or from Settings except the last: goes to the next card.

tour.finish.description: Button on the last card of the welcome tour on the Home screen, started from the Getting started card or from Settings: ends the tour. A verb.

tour.confirm.text.text: Are you sure? You can reopen this from Settings.
tour.confirm.text.description: Question shown in the tour's card after Skip is pressed in the welcome tour on the Home screen, started from the Getting started card or from Settings. "this" is the tour. Settings is the name of a screen.

tour.confirm.keepGoing.description: Button under the question asked after Skip is pressed in the welcome tour on the Home screen, started from the Getting started card or from Settings: stays in the tour.

tour.confirm.skip.description: Button under the question asked after Skip is pressed in the welcome tour on the Home screen, started from the Getting started card or from Settings: leaves the tour.

tour.step.communities.title.description: Title of the first card of the welcome tour on the Home screen, started from the Getting started card or from Settings: points at the Communities tab. The tab's name.

tour.step.communities.body.text: Homeroom is made of communities that build projects together. Anyone in one can propose a change, and the group votes it in. A community is Just you, a Private community or a Public community. Yours are here.
tour.step.communities.body.description: Text of the first card of the welcome tour on the Home screen, started from the Getting started card or from Settings, which points at the Communities tab. "Just you", "Private community" and "Public community" are the names the product gives the three kinds of community; write them as it does. "change" is a noun: a change to a project. Homeroom is the product's name.

tour.step.apps.title.description: Title of the second card of the welcome tour on the Home screen, started from the Getting started card or from Settings: points at the section of Home with this heading, the person's own shortcuts to apps.

tour.step.apps.body.text: The apps you keep close. A small mark says where each one lives: people for a private community, a lock for one that is just yours. The last tile starts a new project.
tour.step.apps.body.description: Text of the second card of the welcome tour on the Home screen, started from the Getting started card or from Settings, about the My apps section. "people" and "a lock" describe two small icons drawn on an app's tile.

tour.step.appMenu.title.description: Title of the third card of the welcome tour on the Home screen, started from the Getting started card or from Settings: points at the Homeroom mark, the logo button that opens an app's menu. Homeroom is the product's name.

tour.step.appMenu.body.text: Inside any app, this mark opens its menu. Tap it, or tap Next to open it.
tour.step.appMenu.body.description: Text of the third card of the welcome tour on the Home screen, started from the Getting started card or from Settings, about the Homeroom mark. "this mark" is the logo button and "Next" is the name of the button on this card.

tour.step.menuActions.title.description: Title of the fourth card of the welcome tour on the Home screen, started from the Getting started card or from Settings: points at the button of this name in an app's menu, where a member says what the app should do differently.

tour.step.menuActions.body.text: Say what should change. It doesn't vanish into a feedback box: Homeroom bot starts building it for you, or brings it to the group as a request, and you can follow along.
tour.step.menuActions.body.description: Text of the fourth card of the welcome tour on the Home screen, started from the Getting started card or from Settings, about the Suggest an improvement button. "change" is a verb. Each "it" is the suggestion, and "a request" is an item the group votes on. Homeroom bot is the name of the assistant that builds changes.

tour.step.settings.title.description: Title of the last card of the welcome tour on the Home screen, started from the Getting started card or from Settings: points at the profile tab. "this" is the tour.

tour.step.settings.body.text: You can replay this tour any time from Settings, on your profile.
tour.step.settings.body.description: Text of the last card of the welcome tour on the Home screen, started from the Getting started card or from Settings. Settings is the name of a screen reached from the person's profile.

firstSession.tour.general.title.description: Card of the short tour a new member is walked through after joining a project, title: points at #general in the project's list of places (its channels). #general is the name of the channel everyone in the community reads; keep it as it is.

firstSession.tour.general.text.text: Everyone in {{community}} reads it. It is with the project's other places.
firstSession.tour.general.text.description: Card of the short tour a new member is walked through after joining a project, text about #general, the channel everyone in the community reads. {{community}} is the community's name and "it" is #general; "the project's other places" are its other channels, listed together.

firstSession.tour.general.tap.description: Card of the short tour a new member is walked through after joining a project, link on the card about #general: asks the person to open that channel, and opens it for them when pressed. #general is the channel's name; keep it as it is.

tour.step.meetBot.title.description: Title of the Home tour's stop pointing at the Messages tab, where Homeroom bot's conversation is the first row. "Homeroom bot" is the name of Homeroom's assistant that builds changes; keep "Homeroom" as it is.

tour.step.meetBot.body.text: Ask it to build a change, file an idea or fix a bug for you. Find it in Messages.
tour.step.meetBot.body.description: Body of the Home tour's stop pointing at the Messages tab: what Homeroom bot does for the reader and where to find it. "Messages" is the tab's name.
